description: Native commands available to the Discord WebView. document_store reads/writes bounded account documents on the operator's configured HTTPS server only, with revision checks, no redirects, no local disk cache, and credentials held in Rust. message_archive offers bounded, validated DM archive operations and paged reads on that same fixed server. Any script on discord.com can call granted commands and could access these operator documents/archives; this is not an isolated security boundary from Discord. history_media resolves short-lived playback URLs for archived Discord attachments without exposing its token. account_sessions manages bounded local browser sessions without exposing login tokens; the same trusted Discord origin can invoke these app-wide controls. graphics_settings exposes only the saved/current GPU preference and local restart, with no arbitrary flags or credentials. Other grants cover notifications, hotkeys, own event reporting/config sync, translation, public HTTPS web requests, and validated provider routes.
